outcomes.reason: ["Paragraph 2 directs the heads of departments and agencies to adopt a liberal policy for granting annual leave over the holiday period, and neither the order nor any held source fixes the last day of that holiday period, so one exact first-end date for the whole order cannot be supported (the excusal in paragraph 1 alone ends on 1962-12-24). Missing source: a held Civil Service Commission or agency leave notice for Christmas 1962 stating the period, or another held text defining it."]

["The flag command runs through the day of interment of Sir Winston Churchill, and no held text states the date of the interment (a held-text search for Churchill with interment, funeral or burial finds only the order itself). Missing source: a held contemporaneous source fixing the interment date (for example the Public Papers of the Presidents for 1965 or a State Department record)."]

["The exclusion applies only while the interest equalization tax in section 4911 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 applies, with its period tied to the date specified in section 4911(d), which later statutes changed; the held texts include the amending orders EO 11368 and EO 11506 but no held text of the interest equalization tax extension acts or of the repeal (Public Law 94-455 is listed by the dossier as absent from the census), so the end instrument and its date are not supported. Missing sources: the text of the statute that ended the tax or repealed sections 4911 to 4920, and any order terminating the exclusion."]

["Section 4(b) ends the Commission not later than thirty days after the date of transmittal of its final report to the President, and no held source gives that transmittal date; section 4(a) was also amended by EO 11309 (18 months changed to 20 months), which leaves the outer date at no fixed day. Missing source: a held text giving the date the final report was transmitted, or an order terminating the Commission."]

["The flag command runs until the interment of Adlai E. Stevenson, and no held text states the date of the interment (a held-text search for Stevenson with interment, funeral or burial finds only the order itself). Missing source: a held contemporaneous source fixing the interment date."]

["The held span for this order includes unrelated Federal Register pages (the dossier reports order_boundary_clause_conflict with 45 scopes, many from a Department of Commerce rules page), so the inventory needs correction by offsets; and the designations continue until the interest equalization tax provisions ended, for which no statute text is held. Missing sources: the statute or order that ended the tax (the dossier lists Public Law 94-455 as absent from the census) and a clean order boundary."]

["The order amends section 4(a) of EO 11215 by changing 18 months to 20 months. Under the strike-and-insert ruling the amended clause continues until EO 11215 ends, and no held source gives the transmittal date of the Commission final report that ends EO 11215 under its own section 4(b); whether the amending order is itself spent on taking effect or continues as part of EO 11215 is also unresolved for a deadline amendment. Missing source: the final report transmittal date or an order terminating the Commission on the Patent System."]

["Section 5 ends the Commission on presentation of its final report and recommendations, or on another date the President determines, and no held source gives the date the report was presented or any presidential termination date. The outer limit of one year from April 8, 1967 is a deadline and not an end. Missing source: a held text giving the presentation date or terminating the Commission on Postal Organization."]

["Section 6 ends the Commission on presenting its final report and recommendations, no later than one year from July 29, 1967, and no held source gives the date the final report was presented; the one-year limit is a deadline and not an end. The dossier inventory also splits the order into overlapping scopes (b, b-1, b-2, b-4, b-dup2, c) and omits sections 1(a), 2(a) and parts of 3 to 5. Missing source: a held text giving the presentation date, or an order terminating the Commission."]

["The order exempts Daniel J. Quill from compulsory retirement for a period of three years but states no starting date for the three years (it was signed October 31, 1967 and recites that he would become subject to retirement during October 1967), so the exact last day of the exemption cannot be fixed from held evidence. Missing source: a held Civil Service Commission or Post Office record giving the effective start and end of the exemption."]

["The order substitutes a new subsection (b) of section 1 of EO 10807 (membership of the Federal Council for Science and Technology). Under the strike-and-insert ruling the substituted text continues until EO 10807 ends; the held corpus has no revocation or other ending of EO 10807 (a number search finds only EO 11381, the EO 10807 text and a codification note), and the dossier lists Public Law 94-282 as absent from the census. Missing sources: the instrument that ended the Federal Council for Science and Technology (statute or order) with its text."]
